description: One conversation with guest detail and media links; include=["content"] returns the writeup.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on the task you are doing. Never used to answer or rank; read only if a result is reported wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline the full body (Pro). Omitted, you get the summary.

slug.description: Conversation slug — date-prefixed, as find_conversations returns it, e.g. "2026-09-01-lukasz-gornicki".

name: get_conversation
